source.title: Trail of Bits: Security Research, Audits, and Tools
source.description: Trail of Bits secures the software, blockchains, and AI systems the world relies on. Browse our security reviews, research, open-source tools, and talks.
source.content:
A field report on rebuilding our own practice around AI tooling: what actually moved the needle, what broke, and where the real security boundaries turned out to be.
Dan Guido · 2026
Everything we publish lives here: security reviews, research, open-source tools, and talks. Browse by domain, topic, or format, and follow the threads into your own problem.
